title: 第17章 推测第18章 王贵妃
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
他带江辰进来本就是无可奈何之举。
毕竟他们四个早早就通过气，要将这份功劳让给铁君卓，来换取铁家的支持。
所以他才随便带了一个人进来，聊表诚意罢了。
至于为什么是江辰，那纯粹是前两天他对这个人有点记忆。
现在江辰一开口，万一回答不尽人意，岂不是会暴露自己随便找人这件事？
到时候如果皇帝心里对他有了芥蒂，那他就亏大发了。
“说吧。”
不管孟望津心里怎么想，皇帝的声音又从宫殿之中传了出来。
“微臣认为，公主就在皇宫之中！
根本没有被掳掠出去。”
此话一出，众人皆是一片死寂，孟望津更是额头上遍布汗珠，背后生出了一层冷汗。
“陛下，他……”
“理由。”
一股无形的力量压在孟望津的身上，让他立刻闭上了嘴。
江辰见此情景也是万分无奈。
如果不是为了系统的任务，他今天无论如何也不会开口说话。
但是照这群人这么查下去的话，那么恐怕永远都不可能查出真相。
“皇宫之中，守备森严，若说有人能够悄无声息的潜入其中，属下认为绝无可能。”
这是个武道昌隆的世界，也是一个集天地伟力于一身的世界。
武圣之强，不可思议。

阻挡那些刺客和潜入者的并不是城墙，而是明皇本身。
这一点铁君卓也想到了，皇宫之中有内鬼这一点是可以肯定的。
但是他们全都陷入了一个思绪误区，那就是公主消失了，那公主就一定会被运出皇宫。
但他们却没有考虑一个问题，
任何想强行带人离开皇宫的举措，风险都大到堪称爆炸。
如果说在进宫之前他只有三分把握的话，在见识到皇宫守备的森严之后，这个把握便来到了七分。
想离开皇宫，要经过三道关卡，每一道关卡上都有十人以上检查。
而这些看守全部都是来自于勋贵，官宦之家。
而且每日轮守的人都是随机搭配。
想要买通这些人，冒着抄家灭族的风险帮助他们运出公主，那还不如直接造反来的简单。
但把公主藏在皇宫之中，这件事却并没有想象当中的那么困难。
“那你倒是说说，公主会被藏在哪里？”
铁君卓脸上一阵青，一阵红，显得非常难看。
虽然他心里并不同意江辰的说法，但他还偏偏不能反驳这句话。
因为如果他反驳这句话的话，就说明皇宫的防卫是有问题的。
而皇宫的防卫一旦出了问题，那就不是一个公主消失那么简单了。
那必须要杀到人头滚滚，鲜血流满整个菜市口这件事才能算完。
那些负责城防的皇亲国戚，功勋贵族们的仇恨，可不是他一个铁家就能扛得起的。
江辰继续说道：“公主没有被藏起来，臣敢断定！
她现在就在众人眼皮子底下！”
content_en:
It was a helpless move for him to bring Jiang Chen in.
After all, the four of them had long ago agreed to give this credit to Tie Junzhuo in exchange for the support of the Tie family.
That's why he brought a random person in just to show his sincerity.
As for why it was Jiang Chen, it was purely because he had some memories of this person from the past two days.
Now that Jiang Chen opens his mouth, if the answer is not satisfactory, won't it be exposed that he is looking for someone at random?
If the emperor has a grudge against him by then, he will suffer a great loss.
"Say it."
No matter what Meng Wangjin was thinking, the emperor's voice came from the palace again.
"Weichen thinks that the princess is in the palace!
He was not taken away at all. "
As soon as these words came out, everyone fell silent. Meng Wangjin even had beads of sweat on his forehead, and a layer of cold sweat formed on his back.
"Your Majesty, he..."
"Reason."
An invisible force pressed on Meng Wangjin, causing him to shut his mouth immediately.
Jiang Chen was extremely helpless when he saw this scene.
If it weren't for the system's mission, he wouldn't have spoken today anyway.
But if this group of people continues to investigate like this, then I'm afraid they will never be able to find out the truth.
"The palace is heavily guarded. If someone can sneak into it quietly, I think it is absolutely impossible."
This is a world where martial arts are prosperous, and it is also a world where the power of heaven and earth combines.
The strength of the Martial Saint is unbelievable.
What blocked those assassins and infiltrators was not the city wall, but Emperor Ming himself.
Tie Junzhuo also thought of this. It was certain that there was a mole in the palace.
But they all fell into a misunderstanding, that is, if the princess disappears, then the princess will definitely be transported out of the palace.
But they didn't consider one question,
Any attempt to force people out of the palace would be extremely risky.
If he was only 30% sure before entering the palace, after seeing the tightness of the palace's defense, his certainty increased to 70%.
If you want to leave the palace, you have to go through three checkpoints, and each checkpoint is inspected by more than ten people.
And all these guards come from noble families and official families.
And the people who take turns to guard every day are randomly matched.
If you want to bribe these people and help them transport the princess at the risk of confiscating their homes and exterminating the entire clan, it would be easier than directly rebelling.
But hiding the princess in the palace is not as difficult as imagined.
"Then tell me, where will the princess be hidden?"
Tie Junzhuo's face turned green and red, looking very ugly.
Although he didn't agree with Jiang Chen's statement in his heart, he still couldn't refute it.
Because if he refutes this sentence, it means that there is a problem with the palace's defense.
Once there is a problem with the palace's defense, it will not be as simple as a princess disappearing.
That must be done until heads are rolling and blood is flowing all over Caishikou.
The hatred of the royal relatives and meritorious nobles who were responsible for the city's defense was not something that his Tie family could bear.
Jiang Chen continued: "The princess is not hidden, I dare to say that!
She is right under everyone's nose now! "
